strategy_roster.name: Four Bar Momentum Reversal
strategy_roster.notes: ROC(4) is percent change, and the four-bar run of negative relative changes is approximated with bars_since; the time window is unavailable. The prior-candle-high break is the documented exit, and no stop is specified.

strategy_roster.name: Bollinger Heikin Ashi Entry
strategy_roster.entry_long: crossabove(close,bb_lower(close,20,2)) and low <= bb_lower(close,20,2) and bars_since(close < open) >= 3
strategy_roster.notes: Regular candles proxy Heikin-Ashi; the lower-band recross and bars_since condition approximate two preceding bearish candles. Middle-band reversion and a prior-low break proxy the 1R target and trailing stop, which are not stateful percentage exits.

strategy_roster.name: Dynamic Support and Resistance Pivot
strategy_roster.notes: The prior two-bar low proxies a dynamic pivot support and the 0.4% proximity is retained; the mirrored resistance short side is omitted. The documented 10% stop and 26% target are outside the requested 1.0-5.0 percentage-field range, so they remain null.

strategy_roster.name: GM-8 and ADX Strategy with Second EMA
strategy_roster.entry_long: crossabove(close,sma(close,15)) and close > sma(close,15) and close > ema(close,59) and adx(high,low,close,8) > 34
strategy_roster.notes: The documented SMA(15), EMA(59), and ADX(8) above 34 long-side rules are retained. The bearish SMA cross is the long exit; StartProtection has no documented percentage value and the short side is omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Modular Range-Trading
strategy_roster.entry_long: (crossabove(macd(close,12,26),macd_signal(close,12,26,9)) and adx(high,low,close,14) < 25 and rsi(close,14) > sma(rsi(close,14),14) and close < bb_mid(close,20)) or (crossabove(close,bb_lower(close,20,2)) and adx(high,low,close,14) < 25 and rsi(close,14) < 30)
strategy_roster.notes: Both long modules are represented with Bollinger(20,2), RSI(14), MACD(12,26,9), and ADX(14) below an explicit 25 fallback; the RSI SMA length is an explicit proxy. Middle-band or RSI reversal exits, while the documented ATR-multiple stop and short module are not long-only percentage exits.

strategy_roster.name: Money Fixed Margin
strategy_roster.notes: The source demonstrates periodic long buying and fixed-margin sizing rather than a predictive signal; the DSL cannot express its 980-bar counter, so an impossible guard avoids fabricating entries. The 25-pip stop, risk-percent sizing, and manual-exit behavior are not represented.

strategy_roster.name: Doji Trader
strategy_roster.entry_long: close - open <= 0.1 * atr(high,low,close,14) and open - close <= 0.1 * atr(high,low,close,14) and close > donchian_high_prev(high,2)
strategy_roster.notes: A body within 0.1 ATR(14) and a close above the prior two-bar high approximate a compact doji followed by its breakout. Stateful doji arming, the session window, and 50-pip protection are unavailable; a prior-low break proxies the opposite signal.

strategy_roster.name: Exp RJTX Matches Smoothed Duplex
strategy_roster.notes: SMA(12) of close versus a lagged SMA(12) of open approximates the documented LongLength 12 and LongPeriod 10 RJTX match. The short block, alternate smoothing methods, and 1000/2000-point protection are omitted from this long-only translation.

strategy_roster.name: My TS15 Moving Average Trailing Stop
strategy_roster.notes: The source explicitly produces no entries and manages an externally opened net position, so the entry guard is intentionally unreachable. EMA(50) is a simple long-side trail proxy; weighted-price sampling, point offsets, maximum-loss liquidation, and step updates are not representable.

strategy_roster.name: MartinGale Breakout
strategy_roster.entry_long: high - low >= 3 * sma(high - low,10) and close > open
strategy_roster.notes: A range at least three times its ten-bar SMA and a strong bullish close retain the documented abnormal-candle breakout. A bearish close is the state-free exit proxy; point target, balance drawdown recovery, martingale sizing, and the 15-minute context are unsupported.
